name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_append_value_status302b_302c
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::AppendValueStatus302B_302C formats and appends localized WOL value status 0x302b or 0x302c.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4412c0 validates the four-argument stdcall callback contract, ignored second argument, 128-byte stack buffer, message id 0x302b when usePrimaryMessage is nonzero, message id 0x302c when it is zero, zLoc::FormatMessage(buffer, 128, messageId, value), WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::AppendStatusTextFmt, and return value 0.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_append_value_status302b_302c_smoke patches FormatMessage and AppendStatusTextFmt and verifies both message-id branches, buffer size, value handoff, append receiver, appended formatted text, and return value.
